ztb.features.momentum.ultimate_oscillator module

Ultimate Oscillator feature implementation. The Ultimate Oscillator is a momentum oscillator designed to capture momentum across three different timeframes.

Output columns:

  • ultimate_oscillator: Ultimate Oscillator value (0 to 100)

ztb.features.momentum.ultimate_oscillator.compute_ultimate_oscillator(df: DataFrame) → Series[source]

Ultimate Oscillator using Ta-Lib wrapper

class ztb.features.momentum.ultimate_oscillator.UltimateOscillator(short_period: int = 7, medium_period: int = 14, long_period: int = 28, **kwargs: Any)[source]

Bases: BaseFeature

Ultimate Oscillator indicator. Combines short-term, intermediate-term, and long-term momentum into one oscillator.

compute(df: DataFrame, **params: Any) → DataFrame[source]

df columns must include: [‘high’, ‘low’, ‘close’]. Returns a DataFrame with Ultimate Oscillator values.

Williams %R indicator. Measures the level of the close relative to the highest high for the look-back period.
